title: How Armstrong got the name Satchmo
summary: Armstrong says a man in England in 1932 greeted him as Satchmo, and his trumpet player explained the name came from his big mouth; talk turns to other names.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Oh, it was way back in the days of London when I was first around there in 1932. You arrived in Bristol. And the bell of the maker was strictly English. Uh-huh. He grabbed my hand and said, hello, Satchmo. I said, what you say, Daddy? You know, but I went to my trumpet player and I asked him, I said, my name is Satchmo. Why would he call me Satchmo? He said, because the man thought you had Mo mouth.
What are some of the other names that you've been called through the years? Well, you married, isn't it? No, no, I've been spared that. Well, you'll find out.
You'll find out all the names. My wife calls me, you know.
